rows.text: The universe is filled with all kinds of spectacles: supernova explosions, the birth of black holes, the Antimatter Legion igniting planets one after another... These are nice amusements for the Fools of the Tavern. To watch these "blockbusters" unfolding dozens of galaxies away in real time, the Fools tinkered together these spectator lenses. The device automatically locks onto and broadcasts the most explosive dramas playing out across the cosmos, making every viewing feel like opening a mystery box. Of course, this kind of equipment cannot shield the user from the blinding flash of an explosion, let alone all sorts of tricky cognitive hazards. It is common for Fools to be blinded by the aftershocks of a cardinal battle, but as they put it, "Even if it kills me, I got my money's worth."
